headline: Ordinance moving the Parking Division into the Manchester Police Department, plus city finance reports and revolving loan fund update.
summary: An ordinance amendment would place the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department. The meeting also includes an update on the Revolving Loan Fund and unaudited monthly financial reports for the first three months of FY27.
items: Update on the City's Revolving Loan Fund
Finance Department reports from Kim LeBlanc: Accounts Receivable over 90 days, Aging Report, and Outstanding Receivables
Unaudited monthly financial reports for the first three months of FY27, submitted by Sharon Wickens
Ordinance amendment placing the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department under Chapter 70, Section 70.44
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON ACCOUNTS, ENROLLMENT AND REVENUE 
ADMINISTRATION 
November 17, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen O'Neil, Terrio, Goonan, Burkush, Vincent 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Update on the City's Revolving Loan Fund. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Communication from Kim LeBlanc, Financial Analyst II, submitting Finance 
Department reports as follows: 
• Accounts Receivable over 90 days 
• Aging Report 
• Outstanding Receivables 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Communication from Sharon Wickens, Finance Officer, submitting the City's 
Monthly Financial Reports (unaudited) for the first three months of FY27. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
4. Ordinance Amendment: 
 
“Amending Chapter 70: Motor Vehicles and Traffic of the Code of Ordinances of 
the City of Manchester by amending Section 70.44 Division Established hereby 
placing the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department.” 
If the Committee so desires, a motion is in order that the Ordinance 
Amendment ought to pass and be Enrolled. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
